summary.es: Senior Full-Stack Engineer con 10 años construyendo productos web de alto tráfico, hoy enfocado en el backend con NestJS. En Qubik Commerce lideré el frontend de tiendas enterprise en SAP Spartacus, servicios BFF en Node.js, y la capa de IA de SafeCore (Vercel AI SDK, RAG y servidores MCP). Sólido en TDD, CI/CD y Core Web Vitals.
summary.en: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10 years shipping high-traffic web products, now focused on the backend with NestJS. At Qubik Commerce I led enterprise storefronts on SAP Spartacus, Node.js BFF services, and SafeCore's AI layer (Vercel AI SDK, RAG, and MCP servers). Strong in TDD, CI/CD, and Core Web Vitals.

bio.es: Especialista en desarrollo web de extremo a extremo: backend robusto en NestJS 12 y Node.js con Prisma, PostgreSQL, colas con BullMQ y observabilidad con OpenTelemetry; integración de capacidades de IA en TypeScript (Vercel AI SDK, agentes con tool loops, servidores MCP y RAG); y arquitecturas frontend empresariales en React/Next.js (App Router, Server Actions) y Angular (Signals, NgRx, Nx monorepos). Trayectoria probada en storefronts de alto tráfico, diseño de contratos tipados entre frontend y microservicios, testing bajo TDD y despliegues automatizados con CI/CD.
bio.en: End-to-end web engineering specialist: robust backend development with NestJS 12 and Node.js using Prisma, PostgreSQL, BullMQ queues, and OpenTelemetry observability; TypeScript AI product features (Vercel AI SDK, tool loop agents, MCP servers, and RAG); and enterprise frontend architectures in React/Next.js (App Router, Server Actions) and Angular (Signals, NgRx, Nx monorepos). Proven track record on high-traffic storefronts, typed contracts between frontend and microservices, TDD pipelines, and automated CI/CD deployments.

expertiseIntro.en: I bring value to product teams by combining solid architecture, agile methodologies, and industry best practices to build scalable software. I focus on solving complex business problems through modern technology, always prioritizing performance, accessibility, and user experience.
